root_cause.text: `mpfs_sys_controller_probe()` in the Microchip MPFS system controller driver allocated `sys_controller` but had an error path after `of_get_mtd_device_by_node()` failure that returned immediately without freeing that allocation, causing a memory leak.
root_cause.evidence: The patch changes `if (IS_ERR(sys_controller->flash)) return dev_err_probe(...)` to set `ret` and `goto out_free`, and adds an `out_free:` label that calls `kfree(sys_controller)`, confirming the leak was due to missing cleanup on the flash-device error path (and similarly consolidates `mbox_request_channel()` failure to the same cleanup path).
